function reservation(status = "RESERVED") {
	return {
		admissionId: "adm_1",
		tenantId: "tenant_test",
		executionId: "exec_test",
		stepNumber: 2,
		attempt: 1,
		purpose: "ORCHESTRATION",
		requestSha256: "a".repeat(64),
		measurement: {
			counterId: "synthetic",
			counterVersion: "1",
			provider: "synthetic",
			model: "model",
			formattingVersion: "1",
			inputUpperBoundTokens: 100,
			contextWindowTokens: 1024,
			costUpperBoundUsd: 1
		},
		reserved: {
			modelCalls: 1,
			inputTokens: 100,
			outputTokens: 512,
			costUsd: 1
		},
		status,
		...status === "SETTLED" ? {
			actual: {
				modelCalls: 1,
				inputTokens: 80,
				outputTokens: 20,
				costUsd: .5
			},
			resultSha256: "b".repeat(64)
		} : {},
		...status === "UNKNOWN" ? { unknownReason: "timeout" } : {}
	};
}
